name: Midas Golden Touch - Reborn
review:
Midas Golden Touch - Reborn revives the original 15-line game with multiplier wilds, a feature buy and a bonus game with sticky wins.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 10,100x cap and a 96.17% RTP.

This refresh of the original game keeps the classic three-row layout and gold-drenched castle, now with a feature buy for impatient players.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
